lessons: Parse object names at the last underscore; category strings can contain underscores.
Assign distinct baskets to categories using current visible geometry, preserving unambiguous existing groupings.
Use basket dimensions rather than a fixed broad proximity threshold.
Normalize the supplied arm-specific downward quaternions and select the arm using source and destination positions.
Use object-centre height plus the tool offset, respecting the minimum contact height; avoid unnecessarily high lifts.
The previous post-lift RGB guard stopped every reported development run before transport. Do not require that unvalidated visibility test to execute a single transfer.
Attempt each initial instance at most once. Stop on primitive failure without arbitrary release or uncertain manipulation retries.

rationale: This revision removes the post-lift visibility gate identified in the latest feedback, lowers the grasp target from above the object top toward its centre, and uses short clearance motions with both arm-specific orientations. Category assignments and containment tests depend only on supplied scene observations. Execution is bounded, avoids persistent-key tracking assumptions, and stops on unavailable perception or planning. Primitive completion is not interpreted as evidence of task success.
